data.one_liner: Generate customizable pin code and OTP input fields with animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable Flutter widget for entering PIN codes and one-time passwords (OTP). Supports custom animations, borders, colors, masking, custom keyboards, and SMS autofill features.
use_when: You need an OTP or PIN input field in your app.
You require customizable box styles, borders, and animations for each pin character.
avoid_when: You are building standard text form fields without segmented pin inputs.
strengths: Highly customizable field styles, borders, and animations
Supports SMS autofill and custom keyboard options
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and Web
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced configurations beyond the properties table
